# Marcel Weigel — Personal Website

> Marcel Weigel is an Enterprise Architect specializing in Enterprise Architecture, Digital & AI Strategy, and Digital Transformation. This is his personal brand website.

## About

Marcel Weigel is an Enterprise Architect at ISS. He bridges the gap between business strategy and technology execution through architecture thinking — a structured yet adaptive approach to aligning digital capabilities with organizational goals. His expertise spans Enterprise Architecture, Business Domain & Solution Architecture, Digital & AI Strategy, Architecture Governance, and Advisory & Consulting.

## Website Structure

- [Homepage](https://marcel-weigel.com/): Personal brand landing page with introduction, philosophy, blog highlights, testimonials, and contact
- [Read](https://marcel-weigel.com/read/): Latest articles from the Architecture Experience blog
- [About](https://marcel-weigel.com/about/): Professional background, expertise, and approach
- [Contact](https://marcel-weigel.com/contact/): Email and LinkedIn contact details, areas of expertise

## Blog

Marcel writes on his blog "Architecture Experience" at https://www.architecture-experience.com. Topics include Enterprise Architecture, AI Strategy, Digital Transformation, and Architecture Governance.

## Philosophy

"I turn complexity into clarity." — Marcel helps organizations navigate digital transformation by providing architectural clarity where complexity exists.
